tei:div.tei:p: 1$0000250rtil bsang yid bzhin nor bu ni/ 1$0000300kye/ sngon gyi bskal pa dang po la// bsang gi rgyu ni ji ltar srid// kun khyab kun bzang mkha' klong nas// yum chen lnga yi cho 'phrul las// dbang chen 'byung ba rim lnga chags// 'byung ba lnga yi dwangs ma las// dri bzang shing rtsi sna dgu 'khrungs// sur dkar dung lo lha yi shing*// nya brid spen ma gnyan gyi shing*// 'om bu bdud rtsi klu yi shing*// mkhan pa dkar po zhi ba'i shing*// stag pa ser po rgyas pa'i shing*// sman shing se ba dbang gi shing*// shug pa g.yu lo drag po'i shing*// thang lo klu gnyan dga' ba'i shing*// shing sna dgu yi dud pa dang*// phye mar 'o zho ja chang phud// bsregs pa'i dud pa sprin ltar gtibs// dhī las lha mo bdug spos ma// dud pa'i lha mo sku mdog sngo// phyag g.yas bdud rtsi'i bum pa yis// lha srung grib kyis phog pa bkru// phyag g.yon sman gyi gzhong pa nas// dri zhim spos dud dpag med 'phro// dud pa spos kyi 'khri shing gis// stong gsum 'jig rten thams cad khyab// du ba'i cha shas re re las// 'dod yon lnga dang rin chen bdun// bkra shis rdzas rtags bza' btung sogs// 'dzad med nam mkha'i char bzhin 'beb// de 'dra'i dpag med bsang mchod 'dis// lha dang srung ma thams cad bsang*// kyai/ 'gro ba kun la bu ltar brtse// ston pa shākya thub pa bsang*// sa gnas sems dpa' thugs rje can// cang shes nyi ma'i snying po bsang*// rta bdud 'dul mdzad khro bo'i rgyal// bcom ldan rta mgrin rgyal po bsang*// rdo rje khro bo re manta// rngog chags yongs kyi srung ma bsang*// lha yi so pa spyan rnon po// dpal rab 'chang ba'i mgon po bsang*// ārya kro dha re manta// sa gnas sems dpa' chen po bsang*// gzhon nu ārya re manta// nyi ma'i sras po chen po bsang*/ khro bo chen po re manta// rta sri rta 'dre 'dul mdzad bsang*// lha dmag 'bum gyi lam mkhan te// lam lha chen po 'khor bcas bsang*// nyi ma khyer nas gling bzhi bskor// rlung rta bdun gyi bdag po bsang*// lha min g.yul las rab tu rgyal// dgra bla yongs kyi rje bo bsang*// dpal dang grags pa gzi brjid ldan// 'phags pa rta yi rgyal po bsang*// mthu dang rdzu 'phrul nus par ldan// bstan srung gnod sbyin chen po bsang*// dngul rmog gser khrab rta sngon can// mtshon cha sna tshogs bsnams pa bsang*// steng nas sprul pa'i pho nya ni// lcags kyi khyung chen 'bar ba bsang*// phrag gong gnyis nas sprul pa ni// lcags kyi bya khra 'bar ba bsang*// rgyab nas sprul pa'i seng chen ni// 'gying zhing g.yu ral sprugs pa bsang*// mdun nas sprul pa'i stag mo ni// 'grol zhing rgyug mdur byed pa bsang*// 'khor ni rang 'dra lnga brgya'i tshogs// zhub can rta sngon zhon pa bsang*// dpal 'byor bdag po rta yi lha// gnod sbyin gang ba bzang po bsang*// rta nor dngos grub kun gyi bdag

/rdo rje rnam thos sras po bsang*// rta 'dre rtil sri 'dul mdzad pa// rta lha mgon po nag po bsang*// zla ba'i sras po rta yi lha// gnod sbyin ku be ra yang bsang*// sprul pa'i gnod sbyin ku be ra// nor lha bye ba'i tshogs bcas bsang*// de ltar bsangs pa'i yon tan gyis// rta drel rngog chags thams cad la// gnod pa'i nad gdon zhi bar mdzod// rta drel rngog chags 'phel ba dang*// tshe srog brtan pa'i phrin las mdzod// rta drel rngog chags rgyas pa yi// rta g.yang dngos grub bdag la stsol// gnod byed god 'dre rtil sri rnams// thams cad thal ba rdul du rlogs// glo bur dgra rkun gnod pa zlogs// bcol pa'i phrin las grub par mdzod// kye/ yang cig bsang zhing mchod pa ni// sngon gyi bskal pa dang po la// srid pa ye smon rgyal po yis// phyag sen rdzi ma so zho dang*// zhal mchil blugs nas smon lam btab// rin chen shel sgong dkar po byung*// sgo nga'i phyi shun las byung ba// gor bu rta yi rta bla bsang*// sgo nga'i bar sha las byung ba// mdo ba rta yi bla brag bsang*// sgo nga'i sgong chu las byung ba// mdo ba rta yi bla mtsho bsang*// mtsho la shing sdong dkar po skyes// rngog chags rta yi bla shing bsang*// shing rtse mu tig shel ru dang*// sprul pa'i bya khra bcu gsum bsang*// rta drel rngog chags thams cad kyi// lus la gnas pa'i lha rnams bsang*// phrum phrum steng na khra gnyis gnas// spyi rje kun khyab dgra bla bsang*// snying mtsher gnyis na khra gnyis gnas// snying dpa' thob pa'i dgra bla bsang*// spyan mig gnyis na khra gnyis gnas// snang gsal 'od kyi dgra bla bsang*// dpung pa gnyis na khra gnyis gnas// rta dgra 'dul ba'i dgra bla bsang*// lag rmig gnyis na khra gnyis gnas// sa dgra thul ba'i dgra bla bsang*// sgal tshigs gnyis na khra gnyis gnas// rlung bas mgyogs pa'i dgra bla bsang*// rtsib logs gnyis na khra gnyis gnas// bya bas mgyogs pa'i dgra bla bsang*// mgyogs pa bya bzhi'i dgra bla bsang*// dgra bla dung bya dkar mo bsang*// mgyogs pa bya zhon dgra bla dang*// mgyogs pa rlung zhon dgra bla bsang*// srid pa rngog chags srung ma dang*// srid pa'i rta lha thams cad bsang*// rta lha nyams pa thams cad gso// rta lha rmugs pa thams cad bsang*// rta lha rgud pa thams cad gso// rta lha bying ba thams cad bsang*// rta lha'i ngo so gyen du bstod// rta lha mnol pa thams cad bsang// rta lha'i dbu 'phang gyen du bstod// rta lha mnyes shing tshims gyur nas// bkrag mdangs gzi brjid ldan gyur cig

/kye/ rta lha gnyan po khyed rnams la// bsang mchod dam pa 'di phul bas// thams cad mnyes shing tshims gyur cig /thams cad mnyes shing tshims nas kyang*// rta drel rngog chags 'di rnams la// rtag tu srung zhing skyob par mdzod// nyin gyi dus su bya ra mdzod// mtshan gyi dus su mel tshe mdzod// rta 'dre rtil sri'i kha khog la// rta nad 'tsher bcu'i ngo longs shig /dgra rkun gcan gzan kha khog la// 'gong po lam dgra'i ngo longs shig /lhad dang sdom gyi kha khog la// zer ma gdon nad ngo longs shig /rta nad kun gyi kha khog la// gdon rigs kun gyi ngo longs shig /kye/ ston pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das// rngog chags rnams la bskyab tu gsol// cang shes nyi ma'i snying po yis// rta rnams kun la thugs rjes skyobs/ khro bo rta mgrin rgyal po yis// rngog chags rnams la srung du gsol// 'phags pa rdo rje re mantas// rngog chags srung zhing skyob tu gsol// dpal rab 'chang ba'i mgon po yis// rta yi nad rnams zhi bar mdzod// 'phags pa ārya re mantas// rta drel 'phel zhing rgyas par mdzod// gzhon nu nyi ma'i sras po yis// rta g.yang dngos grub dbang du sdus/ khro bo chen po re mantas// rta la gnod byed rdul du rlogs// dpal 'byor gang ba bzang po yis// rta g.yang dpal dang 'byor pa spel// rdo rje gnod sbyin rnam thos sras// rta drel longs spyod rgyas par mdzod// mgon po nag po rta yi lhas// rta la gnod pa'i dgra bgegs thul// ku be ra ni rta yi bdag /rta yi bdag pos 'tsho skyong mdzod// 'jig rten srid pa'i rta lha rnams// rta yi srung skyob mel tshe mdzod// rta yi lus lha gnyan po rnams// rta la rten chos srung skyob mdzod// rta lha rta dang ma 'bral cig /drel lha drel dang ma 'bral cig /nor lha nor dang ma 'bral cig /dgra bla mi dang ma 'bral cig /bkra shis bde legs rgyas par mdzod// lha rgyal lo//

zhes pa rtil bsang 'di grags che bar 'dug kyang 'di 'don gyi nges cha mi 'dug pas a rā gas 'phral du bris pa la nyes 'gal gang mchis bshags shing dge bas 'gro ba thams cad bde legs phun sum tshogs par gyur cig /maṅga laṃ/// /
